sentence: This project studies how the microbiome of the cyanobacterium Trichodesmium works and why it exists consistently in the global oceans.
This project builds computational tools that combine molecular data with structural imaging to map brain areas for olfaction in mice.
This project studies how random systems with many energy valleys react when the temperature or the underlying disorder is changed.
This project plans a center that works on making ultrasound systems for sensing, imaging, therapy and drug delivery.
This project studies how the range of roles played by mammals changed before, during and after a period of rapid global warming.
This project builds a tool that uses artificial intelligence and tiny laboratory devices to find out how blood flows in the smallest blood vessels.
This project creates a way to turn the motion of tiny particles inside living cells into maps of how the cell interior is organized.
This project studies how non-uniform thermal stimuli affect the way bistable arches switch between stable configurations.
This project builds a miniaturized device for growing cells for cell and gene therapies.
This project develops an ebook, a laboratory manual and an instructor's guide about vacuum technology.
This project studies how nanomaterials made from copper and carbon conduct heat and how electrons flow through them.
This project studies how laser-induced bubbles behave in hydrogels and how they cause jet flow during printing.
This project uses scenario-based tabletop exercises and workshops to find out what human behaviors lead to security problems in research settings.
This project designs electrolytes that dissolve solid reaction products in alkaline metal sulfur batteries so they can run at lower temperature.
This project acquires a microscope that records fast three-dimensional events in soft materials and living samples.
This project builds computer methods that use nuclear magnetic resonance to reveal the atomic structure of glass and other non-crystalline materials.
This project develops learning modules about how attacks can make machine learning models give incorrect predictions.
